title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 3, ASS-BOO - EB.11
text: BLROZIL, a fatterie Or Evryssel in the United Province, seated on the river A, at the place where it falls into the Zuyder Zee. It has a port sufficient to contain 250 streets, and serves to defend these ships that cross the sea... Its fortifications, which were con- siderable, have been allowed to fall to decay. E. Long. 6. o. N. Lat. 5: 44.
